== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Premiere [[Darth Vader]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label. Use Show changes before saving, then check both the new article and existing family members. The current article highlights automatically.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Darth Vader (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity. Era and set headings are linked, bold and underlined; publication entries use normal links. PC Errata appears as a labeled version under the Premiere design family. Later reprints use descriptive links directly to their publication articles; the article records the actual release product and publisher.

This reversible Dark Side pilot covers the eleven existing family articles identified for the second test. The English Reflections foil is included with its independently verified physical foil face and publication identity. Other Vader personas, including [[Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith]] and [[Darth Vader With Lightsaber]], belong to their own card families.
</noinclude>
